thesisQuality.note: Durable water/hygiene franchise plus accelerating high-tech adoption and an integrated cooling/water platform support the upper strong band, tempered by acquisition integration uncertainty.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 sales +10%, organic +5%, adjusted operating income +10% and Digital +27% show strong momentum, offset by higher interest expense from acquisition debt.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: At roughly 36.2x trailing earnings in September 2026, valuation is demanding relative to even solid growth; this supports the low mixed band rather than favorable asymmetry.

catalystScore.note: CoolIT integration, >25% high-tech growth and second-half organic acceleration are identifiable current catalysts, but the 2030 $4B target is a management objective rather than a realized outcome.

governancePower.note: Long-lived franchise execution and continued capital returns support adequate-to-strong stewardship, while the 29x NTM EBITDA CoolIT purchase raises capital-allocation execution risk.

alignment2036.note: Water efficiency, hygiene, semiconductor fabs, power and AI data-center cooling address multiple durable human and infrastructure needs across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Core water, chemistry, digital monitoring, global service and CoolIT thermal engineering are reusable across fabs, power and data centers, creating multiple demand engines.

bottleneckControl.note: Direct-to-chip cooling and fluid management participate in a real AI heat-removal constraint with qualification friction, but evidence does not establish exclusive control or no practical substitutes.

scenarioRobustness.note: Diversified food, healthcare, water, life-science and high-tech exposure plus recurring service capabilities reduce dependence on one technology cycle, though CoolIT adds AI-capex sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.note: Integrated hardware, chemistry, water and service plus hyperscaler qualification support replacement barriers, but alternate cooling architectures and insourcing remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Global operating scale supports moderate resilience, but cited evidence does not establish exceptional supplier redundancy for CoolIT hardware; unknowns cap the score near the bottom of strong.

pricingPower.note: Q2 pricing accelerated and more than offset higher commodity costs while adjusted operating income grew 10%, direct evidence of meaningful pass-through ability.

risk.note: Primary risks are acquisition valuation/leverage, integration, architecture substitution and undisclosed customer concentration; these are material but do not currently invalidate the operating thesis.

confidence.note: Identity/tradability are validated and current primary evidence supports operating, acquisition and strategic claims; confidence is reduced because issuer evidence dominates and customer concentration/supply-chain details remain undisclosed.

thesis: Ecolab combines a durable water/hygiene service franchise with a newly enlarged high-tech platform spanning semiconductor fabs, power and AI liquid cooling; strong pricing and operating momentum support the thesis, but the CoolIT purchase price and current equity valuation limit asymmetry.
keyRisk: CoolIT integration and debt-funded acquisition economics disappoint while AI cooling architecture or customer concentration weakens expected high-tech growth.
nextCatalyst: Second-half 2026 organic acceleration and initial CoolIT contribution/integration evidence in post-close results.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore records the methodology-weighted component score; risk and confidence are separately preserved for runtime gate/penalty treatment rather than silently double-applied by Alpha.
